profile.name: Victor
profile.summary: iOS developer in Hong Kong actively exploring remote senior-level roles at craft-driven, meaningful, AI-native, Apple-platform, notes, writing, and knowledge-tool companies. Strongest fit is work where iOS craft, interaction design, Swift concurrency, and product taste shape how the experience feels in hand.

preferences.label: Remote required
preferences.description: Remote work is a hard requirement.

preferences.label: Meaningful interaction work
preferences.description: The product must matter to real people, and the interaction model itself should be central to the product rather than a wrapper.

preferences.label: iOS and Apple platforms
preferences.description: Strong interest in iOS, interaction design, and Apple-platform-native products.

preferences.label: AI-first products
preferences.description: Interested in teams building AI-first products with strong product taste.

preferences.label: Craft-driven teams
preferences.description: Prefers small, high-quality teams with strong design and product craft.

preferences.label: Small high-leverage teams
preferences.description: Ideal company size is under 50 people; mid-size is fine if the craft culture is still intact.

preferences.label: Hong Kong friendly remote
preferences.description: HK-based or HK-friendly async teams are a real edge; daily odd-hour US sync calls are a dealbreaker.

preferences.label: Design-minded engineering culture
preferences.description: Prefers engineers who care about design and leave room for craft judgment, not pure Figma-to-code execution.

preferences.label: Warm researched outreach
preferences.description: Outreach should be thoughtful and research-led, asking for thinking rather than jobs, never generic or desperate.

preferences.label: No mobile-afterthought teams
preferences.description: Avoid Android-first, cross-platform-first, backend/infra-only, or B2B SaaS teams that treat mobile as a checkbox.

preferences.label: No hustle culture
preferences.description: Avoid move-fast-and-break-things cultures, remote-as-a-perk cultures, and roles with no room for product taste.

preferences.label: Open to TypeScript for the right mission
preferences.description: TypeScript, React, or full-stack work is acceptable only when the mission and interaction challenge are strong enough.

sessions.title: Smoke-test Locus with curated Apple-native AI/productivity companies
sessions.goal: Smoke-test Locus with curated Apple-native AI/productivity companies

companies.name: GoodNotes
companies.summary: Pen-first productivity evolving into AI; same-city advantage makes this the highest-leverage warm outreach target.
companies.fitAssessment: Excellent iOS/iPadOS and geo fit, but remote policy and current iOS role location need verification.

companies.name: Linear
companies.summary: Remote-first, high-craft product team; gold standard for design-engineering taste.
companies.fitAssessment: Strong craft and remote fit; weaker direct iOS fit, so outreach needs an interaction-design angle.

companies.name: Craft Docs
companies.summary: Apple Design Award-winning docs product with strong Apple-platform identity.
companies.fitAssessment: Strong Apple-platform and product-craft fit; small team means hiring may be slow.

companies.name: Mem
companies.summary: AI-native notes and personal knowledge management; mission fit is strong but stack may be web-first.
companies.fitAssessment: Excellent AI/knowledge fit; catch is current role is full-stack TypeScript/React rather than iOS.

companies.name: Cultured Code (Things)
companies.summary: Tiny Apple-platform studio behind Things; still a benchmark for iOS task interaction design.
companies.fitAssessment: Deep iOS craft fit, but hiring is extremely rare and requires authentic product affinity.

companies.name: Shiny Frog (Bear)
companies.summary: Beautiful Apple-native markdown notes by a tiny remote team.
companies.fitAssessment: Strong Apple-native notes fit; catch is tiny-team rare hiring.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack
roles.summary: Web-first role involving real-time collaboration, offline sync, and AI co-editing.
roles.fitAssessment: Mission fit is real, but this is a stack pivot; only pursue if interaction challenge is strong enough.

notes.body: Catch: strongest geo edge, but verify remote eligibility before treating it as actionable.
Catch: rare hiring; follow team members and wait for a role where mobile/product craft is relevant.
Warm intro through Apple developer community likely beats cold application.
Catch: likely not Swift day-to-day. Good test of the 'TypeScript for the right mission' constraint.
Being a genuine long-time user matters more than a generic CV here.
Love the product publicly before applying; warm community signal matters.
